questions.question: Arrange the words in alphabetical (A to Z) order: 'Apple, Ball, Cat, Dog'. Which word comes first?
questions.explanation: 'Apple' begins with 'A', hence it comes first in alphabetical order.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which word will come third if arranged alphabetically? 'Monkey, Lion, Zebra, Elephant'
